sample_description: N-doped TiO2 powders by sol-gel (titanium isopropoxide hydrolysed in ethanol with urea, N2 purge), H2O/Ti molar ratio R = 0, 10, 20, 30; XRD amorphous; Bruker SENTERRA
conditions: H2O/Ti = 0, 10, 20 and 30 (one band list for the four samples); dried at 60 °C (Methods; abstract says 100 °C)
notes: paper: Eg; one band list stated for R = 0, 10, 20 and 30 together (Fig. 7A shows R = 0, 20, 30); XRD shows amorphous powders and the Fig. 7A bands are broad; the "Anatase" marker lines drawn in Fig. 7A do not all coincide with the text values (one near 285, one near 660 cm-1), so the anatase evidence is weak; rutile (243, 431, 590) and Ti-N (209) bands skipped
